description:
List the forms you own, newest first, with status (draft / live / closed), response count and public URL.

Use this to find a form_id you no longer have, or to check which forms are still live. Filter by name with `query`. Pass `cursor` from the previous call to fetch the next page; `nextCursor` is null on the last page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call. Omit for the first page.

query.description: Only forms whose name contains this text.

name: list_forms
